items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: I saw the Duke’s band at the auditorium.

ctx.x: Noble Sissle’s band. I can’t always — oh yeah, they were in their tuxes and everything. And of course the Duke’s band. I saw the Duke’s band at the auditorium.
